stories.title: Trump suggests new talks with Iran to begin on Monday
stories.description: Tehran has not responded to the suggestion that new talks are imminent. Trump has previously said a negotiated end to the war is close, only for strikes to resume.

stories.title: 'My only son was shot standing up for justice' - inside city gripped by deadly protests in Pakistan-administered Kashmir
stories.description: The BBC gains unique access to Rawalakot, scene of violent clashes between security forces and protesters in Pakistan-administered Kashmir.

stories.title: Two crew killed after firefighting helicopters collide in Greece, as British pilot survives
stories.description: One Danish and one Greek national died in the incident, while a British pilot and another Greek crew member survived.

stories.title: Massive Attack respond after Singapore ban over Palestine display
stories.description: The UK band says they are "surprised and disappointed" by their treatment over shouting "free Palestine" at a concert there.

stories.title: Ariana Grande to take a break from public life amid 'endless' scrutiny
stories.description: The US singer, 33, will "step back from visibility" at the end of her world tour next month, her representative says.

stories.title: At least 13 killed in Israeli strikes on Gaza after Hamas agree disarmament deal
stories.description: Israel says it was targeting military operatives in the strikes on Gaza City, Khan Younis and Deir el-Balah.

stories.title: Ukraine says major Russian oil refinery and airfield hit, as Moscow reports eight deaths
stories.description: Russia's military says it attacked Ukraine's ports and vessels in the Black Sea overnight.

stories.title: Uganda unveils statue of Israel PM's brother who died in Entebbe rescue mission
stories.description: Yonatan Netanyahu was the only Israeli soldier to die as he led a mission to free more than 100 hostages.
